reuse.why: All six month-wide actions share category selection, and the new action uses existing tag, month, spreadsheet, budget-write, batching and undo abstractions.

duplication.why: Repeated category-selection queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income-versus-tracking eligibility guard.

placement.why: Selection and amount logic remain in budget/actions.ts, while handler typing and undoable registration follow the established app.ts layer.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, supporting tests and release note.

maintainability.why: The focused shared selector makes exclusion changes straightforward, though income eligibility remains distributed across individual actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getMonthWideTargetCategories, and the new action uses the existing persistence and undo wrappers.

disguised_duplication.where: Category-selection duplication is removed; the remaining repeated income guard is explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and its hidden-filter exception, without consumer-specific branches or bypasses.
